verdict.rationale: Stripe documents its own batch capabilities on the seller side. A CSV catalog feed, where each row is a product or variant, is uploaded through the Product Catalog Import API, with replace-mode semantics, per-row error reporting and import-status webhooks. The docs also explicitly say sellers can "bulk fulfill orders" via the List CheckoutSessions endpoint. Bulk actions on the agent side are not evidenced: Link CLI spend requests are created per specific purchase and approved individually. Missing for 10: agent-driven bulk operations (e.g. via MCP or Link CLI), multi-item batch purchases or refunds, detailed bulk-fulfillment docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Format your feed as a CSV where each row is a product or variant
Instead of fulfilling each order individually, bulk fulfill orders
